components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action for starting or opening a workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--accent, #0071e3); color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.28, 0, 0.22, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.28, 0, 0.22, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #0077ed); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0071e3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A quiet alternative action that preserves the page hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { border: 1px solid var(--border, #d2d2d7); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--bg, #fff); color: var(--fg, #1d1d1f); font: 600 14px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.28, 0, 0.22, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface, #f5f5f7); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0071e3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Action
components.description: A compact inverted pill for the sticky navigation's primary action.
components.css: .ds-nav-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--fg, #1d1d1f); color: var(--bg, #fff); font: 600 13px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.28, 0, 0.22, 1); } .ds-nav-action:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); } .ds-nav-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0071e3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Demo Card
components.description: Interactive evidence combining a product scene with a concise explanation.
components.html:
Workflow preview

需求到 PR

看见每个阶段如何接力。
components.css: .ds-demo-card { width: 280px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d2d2d7); border-radius: 18px; padding: 14px 14px 18px; background: var(--bg, #fff); color: var(--fg, #1d1d1f); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.28, 0, 0.22, 1), box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.28, 0, 0.22, 1); } .ds-demo-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.07), 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.05); } .ds-demo-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0071e3); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-demo-stage { min-height: 120px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #f5f5f7); color: var(--muted, #6e6e73); font-size: 12px; } .ds-demo-card h3 { margin: 14px 6px 4px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-demo-card p { margin: 0 6px; color: var(--muted, #6e6e73); font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A compact live-state label used inside workflow previews.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 10px; background: var(--accent-light, #e6f0ff); color: var(--accent, #0071e3); font: 600 12px/1.2 ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-status-chip span { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-status-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0071e3); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: WorkStep presents complex orchestration as a calm, inspectable workspace. The visual system is bright, restrained, and product-led: large direct statements establish confidence, while interface previews and status details provide proof without turning the page into a technical dashboard. The system favors clear hierarchy, generous section rhythm, and familiar desktop-product surfaces. Blue signals action and active work; violet appears as a secondary orchestration cue. Motion demonstrates continuity between workflow stages and stays subordinate to comprehension.
keyCharacteristics: Bright neutral canvases with sparse blue and violet emphasis.
Large, tightly tracked headings paired with compact product detail.
Softly lifted windows, restrained borders, and rounded controls.
Real interface scenes used as evidence, not decorative illustration.
Direct, calm copy that explains what the product does.

rules.name: The Active Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue marks actions or live state; violet supports orchestration and never competes with the primary action.

rules.name: The Quiet Canvas Rule
rules.body: Neutral surfaces carry most of every viewport so interface evidence and active states remain legible.

rules.name: The Product Voice Rule
rules.body: Use weight, scale, and spacing for emphasis; reserve monospace for information that is genuinely code-like or measurable.

rules.name: The Evidence Lifts Rule
rules.body: Elevation belongs to product previews, modal focus, and interactive response—not ordinary copy containers.

dos: Do keep most surfaces neutral and spend saturated color on actions, active workflow state, and small signature cues.
Do use generous spacing between propositions and tighter spacing inside interface evidence.
Do preserve real workflow motion and product-state detail when rearranging the page.
Do keep Chinese and English hierarchy equivalent across responsive sizes.
donts: Don't replace product evidence with generic decorative cards or abstract illustrations.
Don't apply ambient shadows to every container.
Don't use monospace as a general-purpose technology aesthetic.
Don't invent performance, security, or adoption claims that the product cannot substantiate.
